pick.headline: Bomb at IRP headquarters kills Ayatollah Beheshti and 72 others
pick.fbis: The South Asia Daily Report of June 29, 1981, listed under Iran the bombing of the Islamic Republican Party headquarters, Beheshti and others killed, mourning proclaimed, and Ardabili named his successor.

alternates.headline: Milosevic speaks at Gazimestan on the 600th anniversary of Kosovo Polje
alternates.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of June 28, 1989, carried Belgrade and Ljubljana radio on the Gazimestan anniversary: Milosevic expected to speak, and huge crowds from Serbia and Montenegro jamming every road.
